item.title: VGHF Digital Archive passes 5000 magazines. Here's what's next
item.description:
📝 The Video Game History Foundation has added over 5000 total magazines to our digital archive, a major milestone in our project to build a first-in-class video game history research library. Our magazine library now spans 46 years of video game history, from 1981–2026. Introducing Japanese magazines You asked, and we’ve delivered: we are now supporting Japanese-language magazines in our digital archive.
🔗 Read more: https://gamehistory.org/5k-magazines/

item.title: We're working on a new RuneScape MMO
item.description:
📝 It's to make the RuneScape universe bigger. But we're beginning somewhere that RuneScape players have only recently started to discover - and that is Ashenfall. 25 years ago, RuneScape began with a world, a small team and a community that helped turn it into something far bigger than anyone could have imagined.
🔗 Read more: https://play.runescape.com/4

item.title: In Ukraine, distributed renewables foil Russia's assaults
item.description:
📝 She either purchased drinking water or filled plastic jugs with fresh water from mobile public tanks, and asked neighbours to carry them up to her fifth-floor apartment. Five solar-powered desalination systems turn saline or polluted water into drinking water – when the sun shines. Economists estimate that total damage to Ukraine’s energy sector now exceeds $56 billion.
🔗 Read more: https://energytransition.org/2026/09/in-ukraine-distributed-renewables-foil-russias-assaults/

item.title: Emitting metadata early makes building/checking Rust up to twice as fast
item.description:
